info.name: Fahmida - Catalog Brands Policies Site Settings Skin Advisor

item.name: 0 Setup
Health check returns success and starts a run key
Login admin succeeds
Register customer returns 201 or duplicate 409
Login customer succeeds
1 Catalog
List products returns a paged list of active products

exec: pm.test('Paged response shape', () => { pm.expect(p.data).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(p.count).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(p.page).to.eql(1); pm.expect(p.pages).to.be.a('number'); });
pm.test('Only active products are public', () => pm.expect(p.data.every((x) => x.active !== false)).to.eql(true));
pm.test('Products carry rating and review count', () => pm.expect(p.data.every((x) => typeof x.rating === 'number' && typeof x.reviews === 'number')).to.eql(true));

item.name: Filter products by category returns only that category

exec: pm.test('Every product matches the category', () => pm.expect(j.data.data.every((x) => x.category === pm.collectionVariables.get('firstCategory'))).to.eql(true));

item.name: Search products by text returns a list
Sort by price ascending returns increasing prices

exec: pm.test('Prices are not decreasing', () => pm.expect(prices.every((v, i) => i === 0 || v >= prices[i - 1])).to.eql(true));

item.name: Limit is capped at 60 products
Best sellers returns up to 12 products
List categories returns text values

exec: pm.test('Categories are strings', () => { pm.expect(j.data).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(j.data.every((c) => typeof c === 'string')).to.eql(true); });

item.name: Get product by slug returns the product

exec: pm.test('Slug matches and rating is included', () => { pm.expect(j.data.slug).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('existingSlug')); pm.expect(j.data.rating).to.be.a('number'); });

Public policy list returns published policies

exec: pm.test('Array with title and slug', () => { pm.expect(j.data).to.be.an('array'); if (j.data.length) { pm.expect(j.data[0]).to.have.property('title'); pm.expect(j.data[0]).to.have.property('slug'); pm.collectionVariables.set('existingPolicySlug', j.data[0].slug); } });

Admin creates a policy and the slug comes from the title

exec: pm.test('Slug is built from the title', () => pm.expect(j.data.slug).to.match(/^postman-policy-/));

item.name: New policy page is public
Footer policy links include the new policy

exec: pm.test('Footer links are built from policies', () => pm.expect(j.data.footer.policyLinks.some((l) => l.href === '/p/' + slug)).to.eql(true));

item.name: Reserved addresses are never used for a policy
Admin edits the policy content

exec: pm.test('Content updated, slug unchanged', () => { pm.expect(j.data.content).to.include('Updated policy text'); pm.expect(j.data.slug).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('testPolicySlug')); });

item.name: Admin unpublishes the policy
Unpublished policy is hidden from customers
Footer no longer links to the unpublished policy

exec: pm.test('Link removed from footer', () => pm.expect(j.data.footer.policyLinks.some((l) => l.href === '/p/' + slug)).to.eql(false));

exec: pm.test('Footer does not expose old policyPages', () => pm.expect(d.footer).to.not.have.property('policyPages'));

exec: f.helpLinks = [...f.helpLinks, { id: 'help-postman-' + pm.collectionVariables.get('runKey'), label: 'Postman Test', href: '/p/postman-test' }];

item.name: Saved footer change is public

exec: pm.test('Help link is visible', () => pm.expect(j.data.footer.helpLinks.some((l) => l.label === 'Postman Test')).to.eql(true));

item.name: 5 Skin Advisor
Recommendations return real catalog products and a disclaimer

exec: pm.test('Mode is ai or catalog-rules', () => pm.expect(['ai', 'catalog-rules']).to.include(d.mode));
pm.test('Summary and disclaimer are text', () => { pm.expect(d.summary).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(d.disclaimer).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });

pm.test('Up to 4 recommendations with product ids and reasons', () => { pm.expect(d.recommendations).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(d.recommendations.length).to.be.at.most(4); d.recommendations.forEach((r) => { pm.expect(r.productId).to.be.ok; pm.expect(r.reason).to.be.a('string'); }); });
